# Monthly budget planner

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/budget-planner/

Compare monthly income with planned and actual expenses, see the remaining balance and export a category-by-category budget.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare a planned food allowance of 6000 with actual spending of 6500 and review the difference.

## Limits and checks

Use one currency throughout. The planner is a manual arithmetic worksheet, not a bank connection, tax return or personalized financial recommendation.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
